title: Phase 1 Engineering
blurb: Simulation visualization tooling and hardware prototyping work that cut processing time 3x and halved a device's cost.
body:
As a Product Development and Research Intern at Phase 1 Engineering, I worked on two very different projects spanning simulation tooling and hardware prototyping.

For the Simulation Enhancement Tools project, I built an internal visualization tool in Python that extended the capabilities of the company's simulation software, enabling direct, parameterized comparison of design outputs. I also built a backend in C for the tool's I/O functions, achieving a 3x increase in processing speed and a noticeably better user experience.

Earlier, on the Reduced Cost Haptic Device project, I collaborated with senior engineers to reverse-engineer an existing market solution, then designed primitive amplifier circuitry that removed the need for a dedicated amplifier altogether, cutting the total device cost in half. I also prototyped solenoid alternatives using electromagnetic simulation and 3D printing.
